nodes.label: UI Separation
nodes.rationale: Goal to separate 2D HUD/menus from 3D scene for clean stereo projection and OpenXR quad layers.

nodes.label: UI Tee Texture (Phase 2A)
nodes.rationale: Duplicates orthographic UI/menu draws into a transparent SS2VR-owned texture for OpenXR submission.

nodes.label: Native Shock Overlay System
nodes.rationale: SS2 HUD uses a 30-entry rect table (gOverlayRects); Phase 2.8 uses this for precise panel extraction.

nodes.label: Left-Hand Panel Spike
nodes.rationale: Crops UI quad layer and attaches it near the left controller (wrist-attached readout).

nodes.label: Right-Arm Ammo HUD
nodes.rationale: Hologram behind right-hand weapon showing ammo/quality using native Shock overlay rects.

nodes.label: Interaction Router
nodes.rationale: Unified ray system talking to both UI (UV mapping) and World (frob/use) with UI priority.

nodes.label: Cursor Injection Prototype
nodes.rationale: Hooks mouse-coordinate getter FUN_1408db1d0 to inject controller-driven coordinates into game UI.

nodes.label: Opaque UI Panel Hit
nodes.rationale: Triggers existing UI cursor injection.

nodes.label: Transparent Inventory Portal
nodes.rationale: Projects controller ray to KEX flat camera pixel for native pick path.

nodes.label: VR-Native Reticle
nodes.rationale: Drawn at target object once position lookup is wired; uses DAT_140f01a50 / DAT_1414d279c.

nodes.label: world_aim_mode
nodes.rationale: Opt-in test for near-object parallax; modes include pick_camera_probe and ray_trace.

nodes.label: aim_project_mode
nodes.rationale: Determines if controller ray is treated as head-origin (direction) or a real point (point).

nodes.label: selection_hand
nodes.rationale: Drives UI/world pointer, beam, and cursor injection.

nodes.label: weapon_hand
nodes.rationale: Reserved for weapon mesh and projectile direction.

nodes.label: ui_virtual_cursor
nodes.rationale: Publishes injected cursor pixel and holds ui_click_input (mouse_left) while trigger is held.

nodes.label: FUN_1404df810
nodes.rationale: Lower UI dispatcher that accepts packed pixels and walks the UI region table.

nodes.label: Native Cursor Bridge
nodes.rationale: Moves Windows cursor to controller-derived pixel before emulating click to actuate lower buttons.

nodes.label: Ray-Trace Selection Prototype
nodes.rationale: First selection path not using KEX screen pixels; calls FUN_1404574c0.

nodes.label: interact_squirrel
nodes.rationale: Alternate world path using AE Squirrel ND.FullRayTest via ss2vr_interact.nut.

nodes.label: ui_hand_priority
nodes.rationale: Latches UI ownership to one hand at a time (last_active).

nodes.label: VR Action Panel
nodes.rationale: SS2VR-owned OpenXR popup independent of vanilla RmlUi.

nodes.label: hmd_aim
nodes.rationale: Feeds HMD yaw/pitch to FUN_1405126e0 before culling to align visibility with HMD.
